title: Photo 010 · USSBBW · 말라카이트 · 쪼그려 앉기 정면 · 북유럽 30대 후반
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph on a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in the frame, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking in from one side so the texture of the skin stands out, sharp focus from head to toe, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Subject: ONE real adult Scandinavian woman in her late 30s, very fair skin tone with cool pink undertones and faint freckling across the shoulders, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, shoulder-length glossy curls, a calm confident expression, real living eyes. She wears crescent-shaped earrings and has long nails with a chrome finish.

Physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, her body so wide that her hips are cut off by the left and right edges of the frame. An immense mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle and drops straight down between her parted knees under its own weight, settling onto the tops of her thighs and spreading down toward the floor, gathering into three or four heavy rounded folds as it compresses, deep shadowed creases between them, the surface soft and uneven, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum. It merges seamlessly into her sides, her hips and her thighs with no boundary anywhere, one continuous body rather than a separate mass, not pregnant. A gigantic bust resting on the top fold, no waist at all, colossal hips more than three times the width of her shoulders and an enormous rounded rear, each thigh thicker than a normal woman's waist, thick heavy calves, very thick upper arms, a full round face. Her head looks small on top of her massive body and her hands look small against her thighs. Every fold and curve keeps its own clear rounded outline with a deep shadowed crease between them, never merging into one shapeless mass. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. The sheer weight of the flesh is visible in how it drops, compresses and presses out to the sides wherever two parts of her body meet.

Skin: Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, natural creases and shadow where the flesh folds, faint stretch marks where the great curves have expanded, the raking light picking out every ridge and hollow of the surface. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Body Art: Her bare skin is painted in polished malachite style — vivid emerald and deep forest green in concentric swirling bands that follow every deep crease and curve around the hips and thighs like contour lines on a map, a thin gold line between the bands. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge and cracks a little where the skin folds. The paint covers her whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: her shoulders, her upper arms, her forearms and the backs of her hands are painted as densely as her torso, and so are the sides of her body, her back, her rear, the lower belly, the knees, the calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.

Pose: Squatting low facing the camera, balanced on the balls of her feet with the heels of her shoes lifted clear of the floor, her knees pushed wide apart by the bulk of her own thighs, her back straight and her torso upright, her calves squeezed flat beneath her thighs with the flesh of both bulging out where they meet, her hands resting on her knees with her arms held clear of her body so nothing crosses in front of her torso, her head level and facing the lens, full body head to feet filling the frame.

Footwear: Extreme emerald-green platform stiletto mules with a rounded toe, the platform soles as tall as her ankle bones, the ultra-thin stiletto heels so high her insteps stand nearly vertical.

Background & Lighting: the polished green bands gleaming, the hard raking light carving every fold and curve.

Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide.
